title: Problem with Nostalgia Graphics Pack DLC in RPG Maker MV

posts.author: LetheAurelius
posts.body: Hi, I got the nostalgia graphics dlc off steam, and tried to playtest the game, but this showed up, does anyone have any idea why this happens?  And how can I fix it?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
When you get an error, you need to press F8, go to the Console tab, and provide a screenshot of the full error trace.
However, as the DLC you referenced does not have any plugins or anything that alters code, I don't see how it can be due to the assets.
When you say "tried to playtest the game," does that mean the DLC came with a demo project and you tried to play that? Or you playtested your game after putting...what into it?
You have to realize that most people here have not purchased this DLC, so you need to explain your situation fully.

After pressing F8, which I had no idea I could do, I realized what was wrong when I was playtesting my game. The errors make a lot of sense now that I think back as I deleted most- if not all image files before importing the DLC stuff. Sorry! I'll keep in mind to check what I did and to get into better detail when explaining stuff here. And thanks for the help, I appreciate it immensely. ^-^'
